notes.notes:
We'll be able to publish the game soon, but I need to say a few things.

Developing a game is a little bit difficult for me. So I think there are probably a lot of bugs hidden (or bared) in this game.

I only debugged this game on two laptops in my house. Therefore, problems can occur on some computers.

So I want you to report the bug you found.

[url=https://forms.gle/4VKFDD5kZvja6bT17]SkyLife: VoxelSurvival Feedback[/url]
There is also link in the game.

I'm really sorry but I really need your help. 

Thank you.
